storyline.real: Vettel jumps both Mercedes at the start and leads. Ferrari pits him under the virtual safety car on lap 11 and commits to two stops; Hamilton stays out, makes his only stop on lap 24 for softs, takes the lead when Vettel stops again on lap 37 and wins by 5.011 s.

mastery.label: Win on one stop, as Hamilton did

eras.briefing: Montreal, 2016. Vettel jumped both Mercedes at the start, and you run Hamilton second, about a second behind, eight laps in. It's cold, and Mercedes is aiming for one stop. Ferrari may not be. Win it.
